assertion: A filtered child reads its isolated parent background. Parent opacity is applied after the child blend; the last control also applies child opacity, so parent opacity must not be folded into the backdrop twice.

browser.reason: Reviewed PNGs and difference images. Chrome preserves the filtered backdrop and applies foreground blending before final source-over; Firefox/WebKit captures omit invert even in the standalone control in this environment. See ../backdrop-blend/README.md. Only one output channel level differs across 14400 translucent pixels; geometry and opaque regions were reviewed.
